project_type: React + TypeScript SPA with Konva 2D Canvas, backed by Supabase PostgreSQL
verification_instructions: 1. npm run build must succeed with no errors. 2. npm run test must pass all tests. 3. TypeScript compilation must have zero errors (npm run typecheck).
environment_constraints: Node.js 22.23.2 available. npm available. Network mode: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES (can install from npm registry). No pnpm available. Supabase anon key not available at build time - use env variable VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
contribution_requirements: Database schema is frozen (v1.1.5). Frontend must query via Supabase client against perfecity schema. Auth uses JWT with app_metadata.role (ADMIN, DESIGNER, CONSULTANT). All runtime queries use snapshot_id not template_id for projects.
key_patterns: Canvas uses integer millimetres as unit. Origin bottom-left (0,0) requires Y-axis flip for Konva (top-left origin). Grid size 100mm. Zoom 25%-400%. One Zone = One SKU. Two modes: DESIGNER (editable) and CONSULTANT (read-only reference from snapshot). Autosave debounced 2s with optimistic locking via version column.
directory_structure: Existing repo has: baseline/, migrations/, tests/, docs/, ci/. New /frontend will be created with standard Vite React TS structure: src/components/, src/stores/, src/lib/, src/types/, src/hooks/, src/canvas/
